title: Block Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🧱️block plugin (3-app: ◻2d, 🧊️3d, 🖐️5d, plus shared module + manifest/artifact crate — 23 crates total) from the old multi-app crate layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout, following CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/TEMPLATE.md and the GIS 2-app precedent extended to 3 apps. Determine artifact count from actual document-schema boundaries in the old code (not naming guess). Full baseline tests, wire-format proofs per app, cargo check/clippy/test on the new crate via temp workspace overlay, then delete old crates and hand off registrar block.
